title: Minimum Calls for Secure Tweakable Block Ciphers
summary: The paper gives five-to-eight-permutation-call constructions, while the minimum block-cipher call count for optimal or beyond-birthday-bound security remains open.

formal_statement.body: For constructions of tweakable block ciphers from block ciphers, the minimum number of block-cipher calls required to achieve optimal security, or at least security beyond the birthday bound, remains unspecified. Determine this minimum call count for either security target.

scope.domain: Call complexity of tweakable block-cipher constructions from block ciphers.
parameters: Number of block-cipher calls as the construction cost to minimize
Security target: optimal security or security beyond the birthday bound
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the minimum number of block-cipher calls needed to achieve either optimal security or security beyond the birthday bound.

progress.summary: The paper presents this as a general challenge after giving constructions using five to eight permutation calls. It leaves the minimum block-cipher call count undetermined.
citation_labels: Bishwajit Chakraborty et al., Tweakable Permutation-based Luby-Rackoff Constructions
